# settlements/pinnacle-rock: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

Pinnacle Rock: the Beast Riders' roost town on a red sandstone mesa at the hyperjungle's north-eastern edge (PLAN.md). So far the rock and the site (P0-P1): the mesa, its ten fins, the Garden and spurs as KSTACKS records from the settled plan (src/40-pr-layout.js), the necanyons and hyperjungle kits read in place, the floor and the far land to 60 km from the scale model (region/: its cut; the open world's fields read in place); and the roosts (P2): deck rings fitted to the stacks, Girder's stalls and perches, climbs, rope bridges, the two lifts and the Stair as records (src/43-pr-roosts.js, PRR) drawn in the Beast Riders kit's maps, and Girder's flyers read in place on them (flyers/); and the town on the top (P3a): one core/city instance (src/54-pr-town.js, PRT) laid from the settled zones, about 600 of the Beast Riders kit's buildings and its ports, instanced; and the farms (P3b): six terraces of field cells inside the palisade (src/55-pr-farms.js, PRF), twelve farmhouses, the gates; and the bands' grounds (P3c): BR_CAMP's eighteen grounds on the top and the floor, hedged, with their tracks (src/56-pr-camps.js, PRC); and the Deep Root cavern (P3d) on core/terrain's KCAVERN: the court, the passage of the tribes, the hall, the light well, the kit's rock-cut dressing (src/57-pr-cavern.js, PRD); and the Garden (P3e): its stair and ramp and the stair up the Heart, its great-houses round the Heart (src/58-pr-garden.js, PRG). Verified: build.py, verify.py --assert. Read README.md
